proposal.summary: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms and CICS TX products could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted via man-in-the-middle techniques.
proposal.affected_product: IBM TXSeries for Multiplatforms 8.1, 8.2, 9.1, CICS TX Standard, 11.1, CICS TX Advanced 10.1, and 11.1
proposal.cwe_quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques.

C.quote: could transmit sensitive information in query parameters that could be intercepted using man in the middle techniques.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request reproduction details and network traces from reporter; ask vendor to confirm whether sensitive data is placed in URL query parameters and whether TLS is enforced for the affected components; coordinate disclosure and request a patch or configuration guidance to avoid transmitting sensitive data in URLs and ensure TLS with proper certificate validation.
